AccidentTwoWays.purpose: Treat the stopped accident vehicle as a blocked-lane emergency bypass: prepare the opposite-lane route shift early, wait for a usable oncoming gap, cross the solid yellow only for the bypass, then merge back cleanly before timeout.

traffic_gap_policy.note: When enabled, the shifted two-way bypass route is treated as drivable immediately; ego performs lane change out and merge-back using PDM waypoints.

legal_exception_policy.note: AccidentTwoWays disables OutsideRouteLanesTest while route-mode bypass is active.

ConstructionObstacleTwoWays.purpose: Make ego recognize the construction obstacle earlier, wait if the opposite lane is occupied, then pass and return cleanly.

PedestrianCrossing.purpose: Make clean pedestrian-crossing cases yield until the pedestrian is fully clear of the ego path.
